cases.name: Amethyst "Ame" Jean Killian
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a homemaker, mother of two. Amethyst had a passion for writing her own music and singing. She was an artist and her favorite canvas was her face and hair. She had a genuine love for animals and had a life goal of becoming a veterinarian. Most of all she loved her family and friends."

Family members described Killian as a loving mother who was artistic and creative.  Neighbor Susan Brown told KSDK she would often see the 22-year-old walk outside with her baby in a stroller. ‘She seemed like a wonderful mother,’ Brown said. ‘They just seemed like such a close, wonderful family.’
